description: This file defines configuration tags, their priorities, override rules, path prefix rules, keyword rules, and functions to derive and apply tags based on configuration paths and hints. It is used for categorizing configuration entries within a project.

methods.name: deriveTagsForPath
methods.description: Derives a list of configuration tags for a given path, optionally considering hints for sensitivity and advanced features.

methods.name: applyDerivedTags
methods.description: Applies derived tags to a set of configuration hints, updating each hint with appropriate tags based on path and hint properties.
